anchor: Plan v11 Q5 — country tax rate cross-validation against canonical published sources (PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, KPMG, national tax offices). Each entry compares our stored value vs the canonical 2024 value and notes the delta.
convention: verdict: 'match' (our value within ±1pp of canonical), 'minor_delta' (within ±2.5pp), 'flag' (>2.5pp delta). source_url cited per entry.
method: WebSearch against pwc.com / kpmg.com / gov.uk / national tax offices for each country's 2024 corporate income tax headline rate. Comparison batch 1 (5 of 146 countries) — remaining batched in future pushes.

US.notes: 21% federal CIT confirmed; state CIT adds 0-9.99% (already captured in us_states_2024.json).

DE.delta_pp: country fallback under-shoots Munich/Frankfurt by 1-3pp; sub-regional file captures variance correctly
DE.notes: CIT 15% + 5.5% Soli = 15.825% + Gewerbesteuer (3.5% × Hebesatz 250-580%) = 30-33% combined. Our country fallback 29.9% is the low end (small-city Hebesatz). DE2 Bayern sub-regional file correctly shows Munich at 33%.

GB.notes: UK Corporation Tax main rate 25% for profits > £250K. Small profits rate 19% for < £50K. Marginal relief for £50K-£250K. Confirmed via HMRC gov.uk.
